subtitle: Standalone WHOOP-strap companion for iPhone.
description: Offline WHOOP-strap companion. No cloud, no account, no AI. Not affiliated with WHOOP.

apps.name: whoopmaxx
apps.subtitle: Your strap, your data, on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Reads your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth and keeps everything on the phone: Charge, Effort and Rest scores, sleep staging, heart rate and HRV history, workouts and a home-screen widget.

No cloud, no account, no subscription, no AI. Not affiliated with WHOOP.

versions.localizedDescription: Second strap battery alert: a critical tier at 5% on top of the 15% warning. Each fires once per discharge cycle; both reset when the strap charges.
